description: Raven Rogue default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/raven_rogue-character-sheet.png (intake.json swatch chips 53,49,59 / 70,65,84 / 101,88,112 / 229,208,184 / 142,68,65 / 103,94,93 + direct samples of the drawn surfaces, outline pixels excluded).
